text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory finishes her training regimen with more energy than usual today.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Phew! That's all for today… Buuut!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I think I can keep going! Is it okay if I do a bit more?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! I'm feeling extra motivated!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. Remember how I ran in that scrimmage for that special news report the other day?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Turns out my dad was watching. He called me after and had nothing but good things to say!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: What impressed me the most? Hm… I was impressed you never lost sight of yourself, even though you were up against all those fast runners.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: Racing is a lot like kendo—during a match, our hearts tend to waver. Therefore, whoever wins the mental battle wins the match. In the past, your heart also wavered.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: But all I saw in that report was you having a good time racing against tough opponents and giving it your all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: It looked like your heart was clear as day! That's a real mark of strength! …You've grown so much, Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …And you know what I told him? I said the reason I've got such a strong heart is…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the support of my passionate trainer! We're the best duo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Saying passionate stuff like that really gets me fired up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All righty! I'm going for another round of training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She called us the best duo… I hope I can continue to guide her with enough passion that she always feels this way.
